answer:
Implemented `GET /api/customers/search?q=...`.

- Case-insensitive name/email matching
- Trims and validates queries of at least 2 characters
- Tenant-safe visibility for admins and assigned support staff
- Sorted by name
- Returns only `id`, `name`, and `email`

Tests passed with `mvn -o -q test`.
